summary.text: Conrad Schoeffter is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Suzanne Prentiss.
He is retired after careers in film and television and in seafood farming.

paragraphs.text: Conrad Schoeffter earned graduate degrees from the Gemological Institute of America and from the University of Southern California, the latter in 1982.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he came to America from Switzerland in 1977 and had an executive career first in film and television and later in seafood farming.
Schoeffter advanced from the Republican primary for District 5 on September 8, 2026.
He said his key messages are no new taxes, capping property taxes by increasing school-system efficiency, and a rent-to-own program to make home ownership possible for young people.
